name: Final Firestore Execution Verification

executionPathAnalysis.executionCategory: E. Mixture of Real Client SDK interfaces + In-Memory Domain Adapters & Transaction Orchestration

details.stateMachineLayer: Real ImportSessionManager with versioned state transitions
details.pipelineServices: Real parsing, normalization, validation, and conflict classification services
details.artifactAndApproval: Real canonical review artifact generation and approval cryptographic verification
details.commitEngine: Real CanonicalCommitEngineService using executeTransactionalOperations() fallback when unauthenticated in test runner
details.domainRepositories: Real repository classes that log graceful unauthenticated warnings and skip live writes in offline test runner

safetyMandateAdherence.reason: Production Firestore database exists in config, but per strict safety rules, synthetic destructive tests and rollback simulations were NOT executed against production data without an isolated emulator.

provenCapabilities: Complete 8-stage state machine (SOURCE -> PARSED -> NORMALIZED -> VALIDATED -> REVIEW_REQUIRED -> APPROVED -> COMMITTING -> COMMITTED)
Cryptographic contentHash and immutabilityHash deterministic generation and verification
Review artifact tampering and stale approval protection
RBAC authorization gates blocking unauthorized and read-only roles
Multi-entity domain delegation orchestration (Trips, Drivers, Trucks, Rosters)
Durable idempotency exact-replay recovery and parameter conflict detection
Rollback error handling preventing false completion audit events
Full audit event lifecycle emission and provenance correlation
Zero unmanaged direct writes in commit engine and zero legacy import bypasses
unprovenLiveCloudBehaviors: Physical multi-document rollback on live Firestore server when a subcollection write fails
Multi-client concurrent transaction contention resolved by server-side Google Cloud Firestore locks
Live security rules enforcement on server-side Firestore operations in a multi-tenant test project
Live serverTimestamp() resolution and latency characteristics on Google Cloud infrastructure
infrastructureRequirementsForLiveVerific: Provision a local Firebase Emulator Suite configuration (firebase.json with firestore port 8080)
Install Java runtime and @firebase/rules-unit-testing / firebase-admin in devDependencies
Configure FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST environment variable or connectFirestoreEmulator(db, 'localhost', 8080)
Implement an emulator-backed test harness with clearFirestoreData() between test runs
